note: Style choices for shorts and music renders. A project config.json may set these keys only. Clip length, pauses, and where a short starts stay in tools/make_shorts.py for every project. Omitted keys keep that renderer's current look.

frame.face-follow: Form of the current talking shorts. The crop follows a face.
frame.letterbox: Wide picture sits on fractal art. The shorts renderer already does this when a face track will not hold.
frame.center-crop: Cover-crop the middle. Music videos and the galactic cards.

words.1: One word at a time, the Perfect Clips count.
words.3: Up to three words, the talking-shorts grouping.

bebas-neue-bold.name: Bebas Neue Bold
bebas-neue-bold.about: Face the talking-shorts renderer already loads first.

bebas-neue-book.name: Bebas Neue Book
bebas-neue-book.about: Same Bebas Neue family, book cut.

bebas-neue-light.name: Bebas Neue Light
bebas-neue-light.about: Same Bebas Neue family, light cut.

bebas-neue-thin.name: Bebas Neue Thin
bebas-neue-thin.about: Same Bebas Neue family, thin cut.

open-sans-thin.name: Open Sans
open-sans-thin.about: File the galactic theme cards point at.

avenir-next-condensed.name: Avenir Next Condensed Heavy
avenir-next-condensed.about: Fallback already listed in the shorts renderer (collection index 8).

impact.name: Impact
impact.about: Last fallback already listed in the shorts renderer.

yellow-chip.about: Talking shorts. Black letters on a gold bar with white side ticks.

white-outline.about: Music videos. White letters, black outline, no chip.

bottom-safe.about: Shorts keep the bar 220px above the bottom. Music uses a 0.86 center, the YouTube long-form band.

lower-third.about: Perfect Clips shorts. Chip center at 73% of the frame height.

golden.about: Music videos. Caption block centered at 61.8% from the top.

youtube.about: Perfect Clips long-form. Center at 86% so the chip clears the YouTube control bar.

easy.about: Easy Token mark. Shorts with no logo key try this first.

none.about: No corner mark. Music renders do not draw a logo either way.
